settings.bio_p1: T Mafianie is an independent artist and creator under Cabana Music Empire, building a sound rooted in ambition, faith, pain, growth, and boss-minded elevation. Blending sharp lyricism, melodic confidence, and calculated wordplay, T Mafianie brings a style that feels personal, motivational, and cinematic.
settings.bio_p2: His music reflects real-life transformation: coming from pressure, turning lessons into power, and moving with purpose while staying focused on ownership and legacy. With every release, T Mafianie delivers clean, clever, and polished records made for listeners who understand the grind, the vision, and the mindset it takes to build something from the ground up.
settings.bio_p3: Through Cabana Music Empire, T Mafianie continues expanding his brand across music, media, production, and culture creating a lane that is independent, strategic, and built to last.

settings.title: Vibe Compressor™ — Analog Character Compression (VST3)
settings.blurb: Bring warmth, punch, and professional glue to your mixes with Vibe Compressor an analog-inspired compressor built for modern producers. Shape, tighten, and vibe your sound with precision.
settings.features:
## Vibe Compressor™ — Analog Character. Modern Vibe.

Vibe Compressor is a powerful analog-inspired compressor plugin designed to deliver punch, warmth, and musical control across any mix. Whether you're tightening drums, shaping vocals, or gluing your mix bus, Vibe Compressor gives you the tools to achieve a polished, professional sound with ease.

From subtle dynamics control to aggressive compression, this plugin is built to enhance your sound — not just control it.

---

## 🎛️ Key Features

**Analog Character Compression**
Smooth, punchy, and musical response inspired by classic hardware.

**Vibe Modes (Smooth / Punchy / Dirty)**
Shape your tone instantly — from clean and controlled to gritty and aggressive.

**Parallel Blend (New York Compression)**
Dial in the perfect balance between dry and compressed signal.

**Punch Control (Transient Shaping)**
Restore or soften transients after compression for ultimate control.

**Built-in Sidechain Filter**
Keep low-end clean with adjustable sidechain frequency and slope.

**Saturation Circuit**
Add harmonic warmth and color to bring your sound to life.

**Precision Dynamics Section**
Full control over:

* Threshold
* Ratio
* Attack
* Release
* Knee

**Professional Metering**
Visual feedback for input, gain reduction, and output levels.

**Signal Match & Output Trim**
Maintain consistent levels while dialing in your sound.

---

## 🎯 Perfect For

* Vocals
* Drums
* 808s / Bass
* Mix Bus
* Master Bus
* Any sound that needs control + character

---

## 💻 System Requirements

* Format: **VST3 Only**
* 64-bit DAW required
* Windows / macOS compatible

---

## ⚡ Why Vibe Compressor?

Vibe Compressor isn’t just about compression — it’s about feel.
Every control is designed to help you move faster, trust your ears, and create records that hit.

---

## 🔐 Licensing

* One-time purchase
* Machine-based activation
* Offline activation supported

---

## 🎵 Built for Producers. Built to Vibe.

Crafted by Cabana Music Empire.

settings.title: VIBE EQ — Dynamic Tone Shaper
settings.blurb:
VIBE EQ — Shape Sound With Precision & Feel

VIBE EQ is a modern 8-band dynamic equalizer designed for producers and engineers who want total control without sacrificing musicality.

Built with a clean workflow and powerful real-time feedback, VIBE EQ lets you sculpt your sound exactly how you hear it — from subtle tone shaping to aggressive frequency control.
settings.features:

Unlike traditional EQs, VIBE EQ combines dynamic processing + visual feedback + intuitive control in one streamlined interface.

No clutter. No guesswork. Just results.

⚡ Core Features

• 8 Fully Adjustable Bands
Control any frequency with precision. Move bands freely across the spectrum and shape your sound exactly how you want.

• Real-Time Spectrum Analyzer
See your sound as you shape it. Identify problem areas instantly and fix them with confidence.

settings.text:
T Mafianie is a multi-talented artist, content creator, and entrepreneur known for his unapologetic lyricism, sharp cultural commentary, and relentless grind. Hailing from the heart of the underground music scene, T Mafianie blends the gritty essence of hip-hop with modern storytelling, creating music that speaks to the struggles, hustle, and victories of everyday life.

More than just an artist, T Mafianie is a movement. Through his T Mafianie TV platform, he delivers high-energy reaction videos, beat showcases, motivational content, and real-time engagement with fans. His content series such as T Mafianie Reacts, reflect his versatility, combining street-savvy insight with creative hustle.

T Mafianie is also the founder of Cabana Music Empire, a hub for rising talent, original beats, exclusive music, and behind-the-scenes content that brings fans deeper into the process. From on-camera freestyle punch-ins to track mixing sessions, he invites his audience to witness the raw, unfiltered journey of an independent artist on the rise.

Whether it’s his music, his mindset, or his mission, T Mafianie is focused on one thing: elevation. He’s not just building a brand he’s building a legacy.
